blocks.text: AI can save you hours on a presentation: from the structure to the slide text and what you'll say.
I'm making a 10-slide presentation for colleagues on how to cut office costs. Audience: 15 colleagues, 10 minutes. Suggest slide titles and 3 short points for each.

items: On the slide: little text, max 3–5 short points.
Ask the AI for "speaker notes" – what to say with each slide.
Ask for a story or example to open with and grab attention.
At the end: a clear conclusion and what the audience should do.

blocks.text: AI can suggest colours, layout and images for each slide. Some tools can even create a ready-made presentation file – which you then polish in PowerPoint or Google Slides.
Check every number and fact on your slides – the audience will remember them.
Claude can create a ready-made PowerPoint file to download (in versions that create files) – just ask for "a .pptx file".
ChatGPT can create a presentation file to download and suggest images for the slides.
Gemini works with Google Slides – on some plans it can help you right there.
